ABOUT AMMAR

A clear idea.
A useful system.
The details intact.

I’m Ammar Hussain, a graphic designer working across identity, campaigns, presentations, publications and digital design.

I care about what happens after the first mockup: how a label reads at a smaller size, how a paragraph sits on a page, and how another person can reuse a template.

This collection brings together independent design studies. Each shows the brief, the decisions and the resulting system. Concept imagery and illustrative data are identified where used.

Actual outputs include editable vector layouts, PDF publications, a native PowerPoint deck, code-based motion and this website. Native Adobe, Figma and Canva source files are not claimed.

How the work
takes shape.

A practical sequence. Clear decisions at each stage.

01

Discover

Review the audience, content, formats and production constraints. Agree what the work needs to make clear.

02

Direction

Explore distinct approaches. Compare the trade-offs with the brief before developing one system.

03

Design

Build the core elements and test them in real applications with realistic copy and image crops.

04

Refine

Consolidate feedback, resolve hierarchy and check the details across every required format.

05

Deliver

Prepare editable sources and exports with clear naming, usage notes and production requirements.
